themeControl.description: Makes the switch drive the page theme: on is dark, off is light. It starts in the position that matches the current theme.
themeControl.visualReason: Changes the page theme, not the switch. It starts on in a dark theme, so on its own it looks exactly like checked (#879).

notifyControl.description: Makes the switch show what it does: turning it on pops a toast ("<label> enabled"); turning it off is silent.
notifyControl.visualReason: Pops a toast when turned on. The switch itself is drawn as any unchecked switch (#879).

schemas.name: switcher
schemas.title: Switcher
schemas.description: Lays children out in a row, and stacks them when the space is too narrow — no media query.

threshold.description: Width below which the children stack instead of sitting in a row, as any CSS length.

gap.description: Space between the children, as any CSS length.

limit.description: Most children that may share a row; with more than this, they always stack.

schemas.name: table
schemas.title: Table
schemas.description: Data table with sorting, filtering, and pagination

columns.description: Column config as JSON [{key, label, sortable}]

sortable.visualReason: Clicking a header sorts by it. Headers are drawn the same until one is clicked (#773).

hoverable.visualReason: Highlights the row under the pointer. Only hovering shows it (#773).

searchable.description: Show a filter input above the table. Alias of filterable.

copyable.description: Add a control that copies the table as text.
copyable.visualReason: Clicking a cell copies its text. Nothing is drawn for it (#773).

selectable.description: Let a row be clicked to become the active row.
selectable.visualReason: Clicking a row makes it the active row. Only the click shows it (#773).

sortValue.description: Set on a body cell: the value its column sorts by instead of the cell's text, such as an ISO date behind a friendly one. `sort-value` is read too.

tabTitle.description: Set on each child panel: the label on that panel's tab button. Without it the buttons read "Tab 1", "Tab 2" and so on. `tab` and `data-tab-title` are read too.

schemas.name: toast
schemas.title: Toast
schemas.description: Toast notification system for temporary messages. Container (.x-toast-container, feedback.js's createToast()) is fixed-positioned below the site header rather than the viewport top -- top: calc(var(--site-header-height) + 1rem), so toasts never cover the nav/logo. --site-header-height (site.css) defaults to 0 and is only set to 64px when the page actually has a .site__header, so standalone pages without one are unaffected.

duration.description: Auto-dismiss duration in milliseconds (0 = no auto-dismiss)

schemas.description: Toggle visibility or state of another element.

toggleClass.description: The class each click toggles, on `target` and, unless `toggleSelf` is false, on the element itself. It changes nothing visible unless that class is styled.

toggleSelf.description: Also toggle the class on the clicked element itself. Set to false to change only `target`.

schemas.name: typewriter
schemas.title: Typewriter
schemas.description: x-typewriter types the element's text (or text) out one character at a time, speed milliseconds apart, with a blinking cursor unless cursor="false".

speed.description: Milliseconds between characters. Defaults to `50` — lower is faster.

text.description: Text to type out. Falls back to the element's existing `textContent`, so it can be left off when the content is already in the markup.

cursor.description: Show the blinking caret while typing. On by default; cursor="false" turns it off. It is a caret, not a character: its look comes from the stylesheet.

schemas.name: video
schemas.title: Video
schemas.description: A plain <video> gets native controls and inline playback on phones by default; autoplay works only together with muted, and poster sets the image shown before playback.

poster.description: Image shown before playback starts, and after the video ends. Without one the first frame is used, which is often black.

controls.description: Show the browser's native play/pause/seek controls. Without them the video can only be driven by script.

playsinline.description: Play inline on mobile rather than taking over the screen. iOS goes fullscreen by default without it.

autoplay.description: Begin playing on load. Browsers block autoplay with sound, so this needs `muted` to work unattended.
autoplay.visualReason: Starts playback on load. Once a frame is showing, a playing and a paused video are the same box; any difference is timing, not the option (Windows CI, 2026-10-02).

muted.description: Start with the audio track silenced. Required for `autoplay` to be allowed.

loop.description: Restart from the beginning when playback reaches the end.
loop.visualReason: Restarts playback at the end. Nothing on the player is drawn for it, as in audio.schema.json (#773).
